description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'TheorySet' web page in an online examination system. It handles server-side events for loading the page, selecting courses based on semesters, adding question entries to a database, setting exam details, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheorySet ASP.NET Web Form page, managing user interactions, database operations, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for initial page load, currently commented out; typically used for initialization.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Inserts a new theory question into the database and updates question number display.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets exam details for a selected course and navigates to the admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown list based on selected semester/year.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number based on selected course and existing questions.
